Hospitalers are Notched an additional time when losing a Contest.

name: War Mage
summary: The most lethal foe, one that can strike without exposing himself. Unfortunately for those that employ them, Mages are much more transient by nature than others.
effects:
A Mage can act as Commander in any Zone. When doing so for a distant Zone, roll a Chaos Die, on a 6 they are Notched. When Commanding in their own Zone, they inflict an additional Notch.
A Mage can also negate their contribution to a Contest to negate the effect of another Arcane Card.

name: PC
summary: Your abilities as a Commander derive from your Disciplines and Skills, pick any three of those following which you qualify for (these can be changed at the start of any Battle.)
effects:
You can exchange this Trait for any other you qualify for, at any time.
Your Tier is increased by one, this can be taken multiple times.
Your Durability is greater by one, this can be taken multiple times.
When in a Structure, you can forgo Moving/Attacking to remove up to T Notches from it.
Your Speed is greater by one.
You can reduce the Distance to any Zone by T.
If you have already participated in a Contest against the same Unit, you gain a Boon to the next.
For every three Units in the Backline, your Tier is one greater.
You may Command in any Zone. When Commanding, you can negate all your other Traits to negate the effects of the Enemy Arcane Cards.
You can suffer one Notch and Corruption to succeed a Contest. destroying Units removes one of your Notches.
Your speed is greater by two.
When Defending, your Tier is 1 greater, and you may Notch the Attacker once if they fail.
You inflict one more Notch in Contests.
You may Attack twice, but each is rolled with a Bane and can only inflict one Notch.
When Attacked and the Enemy fails, you may Counterattack, rolling a Contest with a Bane.
Your Speed is greater by one, and you may retreat from a Zone when Attacked, before a Contest is rolled, taking up to T Units with you.
Your Durability is greater by T.
Your Durability is one greater and your Tier is increased by one when Defending.
When you Move and Attack, you gain a Boon.
Your Durability is increased by two.
You can act in the Backline, adding to the Tier of the Frontline by one.
Once per Battle, you can Regroup without suffering an Injury.
When you Regroup, roll a Chaos Die. On face 6, you do not suffer any Injury. You can roll additional Dice at the cost of one Corruption for each.
When the Round ends, you can remove a Notch from a Structure in your current Zone. You can forgo Moving/Attacking to double this.
When you succeed an Attack, or an Enemy fails, you may coin-flip to remove a Notch from an Ally Unit in the same Zone. Critical results automatically give you the flip.
You inflict one more Notch when Attacking.
Each Turn, roll a Chaos Die. On a 6, you can remove a Notch from any Structure in the same Zone.
Your Speed is greater by three.
You can negate your contribution to a Contest to Notch one of the Enemy's Cards.
At the start of each Round, you can forgo Moving/Attacking to attempt to trick the Enemy; roll 2d6+(your Tier) against the Tier of any single Unit. If you succeed, may force them to act as you wish on their Turn.
If the Distance to a Zone is less than your Speed, you and T other Units can enter it, even if it is Closed.
Each time you Attack or Defend against the same Unit, your Tier is greater by one more, up to 2T.
You have Boons up to your Scholarship to be spent in Contests.
At the start of each Round, you can forgo Moving/Attacking to allow up to 2T Units to Move an additional time.
When Attacking, you can Coin-Flip to increase your Tier by one. You can do so as many times in a row as you wish, but you lose all benefits if any fail.
You gain all the Traits of a Commander Unit matching your Faith.
The Size contribution of all Units played alongside you is rounded up instead of down.
